title: Giant Otters Can Kill a Caiman and Eat It in 45 Minutes

scenes.text: These otters kill caimans, then eat the bones.
Giant otters grow up to six feet long and 70 pounds.
They hunt in family groups of six to eight.
Some hold the caiman down while the others bite its head.
One fight filmed in Peru lasted nearly an hour.
A five-foot caiman can be eaten, skull and bones included, in about 45 minutes.

description:
Giant otters hunt as a family and can take down a caiman, a relative of the crocodile.
They grow up to six feet long and a group can eat a five-foot caiman in about 45 minutes.
Who do you think wins, an otter family or a caiman?
first_comment: Would you take on a caiman with five friends?
